{{Quote|Pashok the Unyielding. I am honored by your invitation.|Admiral Davos|<ref name="Assault on the Starbreeze" />}}
'''Pashok the Unyielding''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] leader of the [[Marauders (White Maw)|Marauders]] gang of [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was hired by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Layek Davos]] to accompany him and his men to the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' in the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]], where they attempted to seize the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Starbreeze]]''. However, [[Cipher Nine]] and [[Raina Temple]] interrupted their attempts and in the ensuing firefight both Davos and Pashok were killed.<ref name="Assault on the Starbreeze" />
